### Step 1 — Scene
A breakfast tray with bread, a fried egg, avocado, blueberries, fruit yogurt, two glasses of juice, and individual spread packets. I include the foods on this tray, but not the containers’ weight.

### Step 2 — Vessels
- Main plate: approximately **26 cm** diameter; area **531 cm²**.
- Blueberry bowl: approximately **16 cm** diameter; area **201 cm²**.
- Glasses: approximately **6.2 cm mean internal diameter**, allowing for taper; cross-sectional area about **30 cm²** each.
- Yogurt cup and spread packets are estimated from their visible container dimensions.

### Steps 3–6 — Items, coverage, volume, and weight
Coverage percentages refer to each item’s own vessel. Heights are average food thicknesses, not maximum heights.

| Item | Vessel coverage | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| White bread, apparently two stacked slices | 30% of plate | 159 × 1.2 = 191 ml | 0.30 | 57 |
| Fried egg | 20% of plate | 106 × 0.5 = 53 ml | 0.98 | 52 |
| Avocado slices | 17% of plate | 90 × 1.4 = 126 ml | 0.65 | 82 |
| Blueberries | 33% of bowl | 66 × 1.65 = 109 ml | 0.60 | 65 |
| Fruit yogurt | 100% of cup interior | 24 × 7 = 168 ml | 1.0 | 170 |
| Yellow fruit juice, two glasses | 100% of each liquid surface | 2 × 30 × 9.6 = 576 ml | 1.04 | 600 |
| Honey, apparent gold packet | 100% of packet interior | 12 × 0.8 = 9.6 ml | 1.45 | 14 |
| Jam, red-and-white packet | 100% of packet interior | 12 × 0.9 = 10.8 ml | 1.30 | 14 |
| Peanut butter | 100% of packet interior | 16 × 1.2 = 19 ml | 1.10 | 21 |

The main plate is approximately **67% covered**, consistent with the visible empty areas. The spread identities and quantities are less certain because their packets are closed. No separate oil or dressing is visibly measurable.

### Step 7 — Energy
| Item | kcal per 100 g | Estimated kcal |
|---|---:|---:|
| Bread | 265 | 151 |
| Fried egg, as cooked | 180 | 94 |
| Avocado | 160 | 131 |
| Blueberries | 57 | 37 |
| Fruit yogurt | 100 | 170 |
| Juice | 46 | 276 |
| Honey | 304 | 43 |
| Jam | 250 | 35 |
| Peanut butter | 590 | 124 |

### Step 8 — Sanity check
Estimated total: **1,175 g and 1,060 kcal**, including approximately **600 g of beverages**. The main plate itself contains about **191 g**, which is plausible for the modest portion shown. Juice, yogurt, and spreads account for much of the additional weight and energy.
